answer: Ferrous-capacity work auction. Each agent identity must win at least one paid task per epoch by submitting a signed result whose verification cost (compute plus storage) is paid upfront from its own balance. The posted signal of completed work is checked against a violet-tagged audit hash; clones that cannot win real tasks exhaust their float and are evicted. An attacker running N clones pays N times the verification and audit overhead while earning from at most one, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
